name: vaultysclaw
description: Agent identity and trust: a VaultysId certificate ledger control plane, its Go SDK, and the workload sensor

scripts.controlplane:webhook:prisma: mkdir -p packages/webhook-dispatcher/prisma && cp packages/controlplane/prisma/schema.prisma packages/webhook-dispatcher/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @vaultysclaw/webhook-dispatcher exec prisma generate
scripts.controlplane:webhook:dev: pnpm controlplane:webhook:prisma && sh -c 'set -a; [ -f packages/controlplane/.env ] && . ./packages/controlplane/.env; set +a; BULLMQ_PREFIX=${BULLMQ_PREFIX:-vaultysclaw-controlplane} exec pnpm --filter @vaultysclaw/webhook-dispatcher dev'
scripts.sensor:start: cd vaultysclaw-sensor && VCS_COLLECTOR_URL=http://localhost:8081 VCS_DEBUG=true go run ./cmd/sensor run
